## SigmaPlot version

If known, provide the SigmaPlot generation or version that created the JNB.

## Observed result

Choose or describe the observed state:

`RECOVERED`

`RECOVERED WITH SCIENTIFIC WARNING`

`FAILED`

Other:

## Expected scientific data

Describe the expected worksheet names, dimensions, column names, numeric values, text values, or missing-value states. Independent CSV or XLSX ground truth is especially useful.

## Reproduction details

Provide the JNB Recover version and platform.

## File sharing safety

Do not attach confidential, proprietary, personal, or restricted files. Attach a JNB only when you have the right to publish it. A minimal synthetic or public fixture is preferred.
